column1: # WFIP-0003: the Kokkos DIA (W3SNL1) against the Fortran DIA, one KOKKOS executable, every shared-memory OpenMP NL1 entry of WW3 matrix.base
# full run, --omp: switch with NL1 and OMPG or OMPH, no MPI, no -p, no -m (25 entries, all ww3_ts3, all OMPG; the 25 mww3_test_05 -m twins
# are left out because the port refuses IMOD > 1, WW3 model/src/w3initmd.F90:754-759). matrix.base's -f -O -n $np kept, $np = OMP_NUM_THREADS.
#   ww3-gpu commit: 551684a (dirty: the --omp selection of this commit)
#   machine: Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900, 32 hardware threads (nproc --all), OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 per entry, OMP_MAX_ACTIVE_LEVELS=2 for both runs
# OMP_MAX_ACTIVE_LEVELS=2: without it every Kokkos run aborts at the first DIA call ("Kokkos::OpenMP: Nested parallelism requires the
#   maximum active levels to be larger than 1"), since the shim is called inside W3WAVE's !$OMP PARALLEL region (w3wavemd.F90:2240-2243,
#   w3srcemd.F90:1275); first try, same commit, entries 1-4: ran=fortran-only on all four
# test_comp: files differing/compared (WW3 test.comp, bytes); nccmp_tol: kokkos/tools/nccmp-tol/tolerances.txt, unchanged
